definitions.gloss: without exception; all; entirely; every single one
definitions.explanation: Indicates that something applies to every member of a group with no exceptions.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{残|のこ}らず⟦{食|た}べて→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦しまった→しまう：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I ate all the snacks without leaving any.

examples.japanese: ⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{残|のこ}らず⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: All the participants gathered without exception.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{残|のこ}らず⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I checked all the documents without missing any.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From ⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧ (to remain) + ず (classical negative suffix). Literally "without remaining" — nothing is left behind.

USAGE:
Often used with verbs of collection, consumption, or checking to emphasize completeness. Modifies the verb directly as an adverb.
- {残|のこ}らず⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat every last bit
- {残|のこ}らず⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to collect all of them
- {残|のこ}らず⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to check every single one

COMMON VARIANT:
- ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧{残|のこ}らず: every single person, without exception

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{全部|ぜんぶ}→全部：02888_zenbu⟧: all (most neutral, everyday)
- ⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧: all, everything (slightly more formal)
- ⟦ことごとく→ことごとく：noentry⟧: each and every one (literary)
- ⟦{余|あま}すところなく→余すところなく：25918_amasutokoronaku⟧: without omission (formal)
